newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P gives AA to Australia Wheat Board's dual notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives AA to Australia Wheat Board's dual notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had assigned its AA rating to the Australian Wheat Board's (AWB) six billion yen worth of yen/New Zealand dollar dual-currency Euro medium-term notes due September 28, 1998.

The rating reflected AWB's exclusive control of the export of wheat produced in Australia, its status as a statutory corporation of the commonwealth of Australia, the underwriting of its debt by the commonwealth and the growing equity base provided by the Wheat Industry Fund.
It said the rating was constrained by the AA foreign currency sovereign rating of Australia. The foreign currency rating outlook was positive, it said.
